component.name: GuideRow
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.focusBar = m.top.findNode("focusBar") m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.name = m.top.findNode("name") m.now = m.top.findNode("now") m.progBg = m.top.findNode("progBg") m.progAccent = m.top.findNode("progAccent") m.progTitle = m.top.findNode("progTitle") m.progMeta = m.top.findNode("progMeta") m.liveBadgeBg = m.top.findNode("liveBadgeBg") m.liveBadge = m.top.findNode("liveBadge")
m.colors = [ "0x2A1B4AFF", ' purple "0x1E3A5FFF", ' blue "0x3F1D38FF", ' magenta "0x1F3A2CFF", ' green "0x4A2F1BFF", ' amber "0x3B1F1FFF" ' red-brown ] m.accents = [ "0x7C3AEDFF", "0x3B82F6FF", "0xEC4899FF", "0x10B981FF", "0xF59E0BFF", "0xEF4444FF" ] end sub
sub onContentChange() it = m.top.itemContent if it = invalid then return m.poster.uri = it.HDGRIDPOSTERURL m.name.text = it.title m.now.text = "Now: " + it.description m.progTitle.text = it.description m.progMeta.text = it.shortDescriptionLine1 ' Cycle color by index (Roku exposes it via id if we choose to use it; ' fallback to hash of title so the whole guide is not one color). idx = Abs(hashCode(it.title)) mod m.colors.Count() m.progBg.color = m.colors[idx] m.progAccent.color = m.accents[idx] hasLive = it.shortDescriptionLine2 if hasLive = "1" m.liveBadgeBg.opacity = 1 m.liveBadge.opacity = 1 else m.liveBadgeBg.opacity = 0 m.liveBadge.opacity = 0 end if end sub
sub onFocusChange() p = m.top.focusPercent m.focusBar.opacity = p if p > 0.5 m.bg.color = "0x1B1B1BFF" else m.bg.color = "0x00000000" end if end sub
function hashCode(s as string) as integer h = 0 for i = 0 to Len(s) - 1 h = (h * 31 + Asc(Mid(s, i + 1, 1))) mod 100003 end for return h end function
